pairs.title: Polish zloty in euros
pairs.description: How many euros PLN 1 buys. A rising number means a stronger Polish zloty. Starts in 1995, with the redenominated zloty of 1995; earlier years are in older currency units.
pairs.source: Derived: World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF annual average (PLN per US$) and the annual average of Federal Reserve H.10 DEXUSEU, € per PLN 1 = (US$ per PLN 1) ÷ (US$ per €1).

pairs.title: Polish zloty in US dollars
pairs.description: How many US dollars PLN 1 buys. A rising number means a stronger Polish zloty. Starts in 1995, with the redenominated zloty of 1995; earlier years are in older currency units.
pairs.source: World Bank series PA.NUS.FCRF · official exchange rate, annual average, shown as 1 ÷ the published PLN per US$.
